annotations.title: List decisions on attack surface items

description: List people's decisions on Attack surface "Needs you" items, newest first: "It's handled" claims with their re-check (checking, fixed, still present or failed) and "Meant to be public" items, including those raised again by a material change and what changed. Open decisions can be undone with undo_attack_surface_decision. Every role can read them; not available to every organisation yet, and refused until it is.

changedOnly.description: Only items kept public that Odin raised again because something material changed on the host.
